Ensure seamless treasury execution regarding share buybacks, equity settlement funding, and international cash repatriation for stock plan payouts. Lead the annual insurance renewal process, working closely with brokers to negotiate optimal premiums and coverage limits. Evaluate enterprise-wide risks and collaborate with operational teams to implement loss-prevention and risk-mitigation strategies. We are hiring for three areas (these can be three different people): • Market Communication (MaKo) • Billing & Tariffing • Device Management & Smart Metering What you will do: • Advise German distribution system operators (VNB), metering point operators (MSB) and energy suppliers • Analyse existing IS-U / S/4HANA Utilities landscapes and take part in the migration: data, testing, cutover, go-live • Design end-to-end processes in your area, based on SAP standard • Run workshops with business and project teams on the client side What we are looking for: • At least 2 years of experience as an SAP IS-U or S/4HANA Utilities consultant • Experience in the German energy sector and knowledge of its regulations (e.g. GPKE, EnWG, MsbG, WiM, GeLi Gas) • Hands-on experience with EDIFACT messages (UTILMD, MSCONS, INVOIC, REMADV, etc.) • Experience customising SAP Utilities processes • Fluent German (min. C1) and English (min. B2) Nice to have: • SAP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP BTP, SAP MaCo Cloud • Experience with S/4HANA migrations • SAP Fiori, process automation What we offer: • Good market salary on an employment contract (depending on experience) • Remote work with no mandatory office days and flexible hours • Occasional travel to Germany, on average once a quarter for a few days • Training budget and paid SAP certifications • Extended paid leave • German and English lessons during working hours • A short process: HR interview (including a language check) → interview with managers → possibly a client meeting

We welcome motivated sales professionals who are fluent in English and Arabic and are eager to advance their careers by joining our prestigious villa residence project in Bahçeşehir, Istanbul.
